lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Mailbox day. Bills, a pizza menu, and one envelope with the university's crest.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: They found your new address. Universities always do.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You open it by the mailboxes anyway. Suspense is for people with savings.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Installments start this month. Miss them, and the apartment's on the line.

lines.speaker: neighbor
lines.text: University crest? My cousin got one of those. He lives in his car now.

lines.speaker: neighbor
lines.text: Hang in there. If you move out, I call dibs on the parking spot.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Comforting, in the way a fire alarm is.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Upstairs, you run the numbers twice. Same answer both times.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Rent, shifts, groceries, and now this. The kitchen feels smaller.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It goes on the fridge, next to the shift schedule.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Two papers that own your life now. At least they're organized.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Forty minutes on hold to hear 'non-negotiable', said very kindly.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The installments stand. You pin the letter up anyway. Arguing was free.
